title: Platform Security and Encryption Overview
content: Security is a top priority at CloudDash. All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3, and all data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. CloudDash is SOC 2 Type II certified and compliant with GDPR and HIPAA regulations. We do not store raw credentials; all cloud integrations rely on secure, role-based access (such as AWS IAM AssumeRole). Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is strongly recommended for all users and can be enforced globally by team administrators on Pro and Enterprise plans. We also perform regular third-party penetration testing and vulnerability scans to ensure our systems remain resilient against emerging threats.
